name: MNEE USD
oneLiner: MNEE is a USD stablecoin backed by short-dated U.S. Treasuries and cash at qualified custodians, attested by Wolf and Company under Antigua FSRC license.
collateral: U.S. Treasury bills (≤90-day duration) and USD cash held by a qualified custodian under the issuer's Antigua & Barbuda FSRC license
pegMechanism: Fiat-backed 1:1 with USD; tokens minted upon deposit of USD and burned upon redemption; reserves held at a qualified custodian

applicabilityBasis.summary: MNEE is a USD-backed stablecoin issued by MNEE Limited with contractual mint and redemption rights for verified customers.

genius.notes: MNEE Limited is an Antigua-incorporated issuer holding an FSRC Class A Digital Asset Business License. The GENIUS Act was enacted July 18, 2025 but is not yet effective (effective date: January 18, 2027 at the latest, or 120 days after final rules). MNEE holds no U.S. PPSI approval, state-qualified status, or public foreign-issuer registration. The foreign payment stablecoin issuer (FPSI) registration pathway (OCC) is still being defined through NPRMs with comment periods through mid-2026; no FPSI registration is yet possible. No issuer announcement of a formal GENIUS Act compliance filing was found — a third-party Medium article describes a possible compliance strategy but is not an issuer disclosure.

mintAuthority.summary: MNEE uses a threshold-signature validator set: minting requires 3-of-5 current isMinter addresses to co-sign (admin EOA + 4 independent signers). The proxy admin is a ProxyAdmin contract owned by an EOA. All 5 current minters confirmed via isMinter() on-chain; the admin EOA is also confirmed as an EOA (no code).

controls.label: MNEE minter validator set (3-of-5)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294738: roleHolders() = 4, requiredSignatures() = 3 (constants in source). ChangeMinter event reconstruction confirms 5 active isMinter addresses: admin EOA 0x00C81F5f… plus four signer addresses (0x5502cadb…, 0x1adda839…, 0x8245faef…, 0x863879ef…). isMinter() returned true for all five. The admin was set isMinter in the initializer; the four signers were set via replaceValidator. Three of the four non-admin signers are EOAs; 0x1adda839… is a 23-byte contract (stub).

controls.label: MNEE token admin (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294738, admin() returned this address; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). The admin role can call replaceValidator (with required co-signatures) to rotate the minter set.

controls.label: MNEE EIP-1967 ProxyAdmin contract
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294738, EIP-1967 admin slot returned 0xa3b670f2dd1722c3d4b98f146467840540c2c53e; owner() on that ProxyAdmin returned EOA 0x3de5F6B51E7E154b12D1D8F3a4708848cd729974 (eth_getCode = empty, confirmed EOA).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294738: roleHolders()=4 (constant), requiredSignatures()=3 (constant). ChangeMinter event log (9 events) reconstructed current minter set as 5 addresses. isMinter() confirmed true for all 5. Proxy admin contract identified, its owner is an EOA (no bytecode). Source code confirms threshold-signature minting; no on-chain enumerable role list — membership confirmed from event reconstruction. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): Wolf & Company, P.C. performs monthly independent reserve attestations; the latest report covers 2026-05-29 and was published 2026-06-10, reconciling MNEE in circulation to reserve assets. Antigua and Barbuda FSRC's directory matches MNEE Limited, but its listed digital-asset custody authorization is not prudential stablecoin-issuer supervision.
